explanation: Leader corresponds to coach: In team management, a leader refers to the person responsible for guiding and managing the team. In football, a coach refers to the person responsible for guiding and managing the team. Both the leader and coach play a guiding and managerial role in the team.

Team member corresponds to player: In team management, a team member refers to an individual who participates in the team's work. In football, a player refers to an athlete who participates in the game. Both team members and players are executors in the team, working together to achieve the goal.

Target corresponds to goal: In team management, a target refers to the direction in which the team collectively strives to achieve a certain purpose. In football, a goal refers to the objective that the team strives to achieve in order to win the game. Both the target and goal are the direction of team effort and the result of achieving it.

background.source: Team management is an essential skill for any leader or organization that aims to achieve success. It involves guiding a group of team members towards a common objective through effective communication, planning, and problem-solving. An effective team manager must identify the strengths and weaknesses of each team member and assign tasks accordingly to maximize productivity. Additionally, a good team manager must possess the ability to address conflict within the team and motivate individuals to reach their full potential. Teams are an essential element in achieving business goals, where different types of teams, such as management, work, parallel and project teams all come together to drive progressive and collaborative work. Overall, successful team management lies in the attentiveness and awareness of each team member's strengths, weaknesses and the establishment of the team's target objective.
background.target: American football, also known as gridiron, is a popular team sport played in the United States and Canada. The game involves two teams of eleven players each, with the aim of advancing down the rectangular field and scoring points by either running with the ball into the opposing team's end zone for a touchdown or kicking the ball through the opponent's goalposts. The offense attempts to score against the defense, which tries to stop them and take control of the ball. The game is played with a set of rules that have evolved over time, including rule changes that have legalized the forward pass and established the concept of downs. American football is played at various levels, from youth football to high-school, college, and professional football. The National Football League (NFL) is the most popular professional league in the world, with the highest average attendance and revenue of around US$15 billion. Every team has a coach who oversees the training and strategies of the players, as they work together towards achieving a common goal of winning the game.
